title: MILAN HAD AN EXTRA MAN AND STILL LOST 2-0 AT SAN SIRO
description:
Three points from four games, 28th of 36, and a coach questioning his own preparation.

Ferencvaros won 2-0 in the Europa League, and Lenny Joseph scored both goals within 14 minutes after half-time. Milan had the extra man from the 77th minute. The first goal came after a mistake by backup keeper Lorenzo Torriani.

Ruben Amorim said his side were not mentally ready, and questioned his own preparation. A coach who blames the coach. Rare.

Milan have lost one Serie A game in ten, but three European games out of four. Amorim says they cannot yet do both. One competition at a time, then.

Is Amorim right that Milan cannot yet do both, or is that an excuse? Where do you stand?
